content: Determinism (Unity Discussions, shaderfun series, BEPU/zacksinisi, cross-checked): PhysX is not deterministic run-to-run or cross-platform; float nondeterminism comes from FastMath/compiler reordering, transcendental lib differences, hardware, and summation order; mitigation = fixed timestep + identical precision or (preferred) fixed-point math, custom math lib, no precompiled physics in the authoritative path, never feed float results into the sim, deterministic creation order.
